item.title: Conduit v4.1.9
item.description:
Conduit 4.1.9 | conduit
## What's Changed * Make the test suite faster and leaner by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/774 * On-device web search, model logos, and chat polish for Direct models by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/775 * Fix iOS attachment panel height feedback loop by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/783 * feat(chat): native image viewer with gallery paging by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/792 * Fix sign-in, Direct, Hermes and chat bugs found in an iOS UI test pass by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/790 * Fix notes, channels, workspace and settings bugs found in an iOS UI test pass by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/791 * Forget Direct and Hermes connections on sign-out; keep channel threads live by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/793 * Split AppDelegate into per-bridge files behind ConduitBridgeHost by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/794 * Move the chat library and Flutter-free app logic into conduit_core by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/795 * Move feature logic out of widgets into conduit_core by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/796 * Put CarPlay, SF Symbol images and Apple models behind host ports by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/797 * Move workspace, Hermes and composer rules into conduit_core by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/798 * Move notes audio, web embeds and tablet sidebar rules into conduit_core by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/799 * Fix edit-and-resend, workspace refresh and settings locale; pin startup rules by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/800 * Fix bounded web search tools being skipped by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/803 * Fix Hermes Desktop Gateway setup and Android speech language recovery by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/804
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/compare/v4.1.8...v4.1.9

item.title: Conduit v4.1.8
item.description:
Conduit 4.1.8 | conduit
## What's Changed * Extract shared packages from the mobile app by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/753 * Fix issues found in a simulator verification pass by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/756 * Refine chat, composer, sidebar, and settings UI by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/761 * Fix Android entry points, shares, folders, STT, and keyboard insets by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/766 * Fix streaming lag, tool-call walls, speaker routing, SVG-sniffed PNGs, and lingering Hermes approvals by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/767 * Fix remaining Open WebUI streaming events and task checklists by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/771 * Make icons and settings surfaces follow the theme palette, and fix sign-in from the settings sheet by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/772 * Build iOS and Android targets for ARM only by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/773
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/compare/v4.1.7...v4.1.8
